_doc: What the shaders share with the C++ core or the scripts, written once (tools/build/shader_contracts.py makes native/src/core/shader_contracts.h and project/render/shaders/shader_contracts.gdshaderinc from it, and the scripts read it as CityStore.constants.shader; quick's shader_contracts task fails when they are older than this table). Each entry: name, type (int, float, or enum with its values), value (a number, or an expression both C++ and the shading language read the same) and doc (what it means, who writes it and who reads it). A side that needs a value derived from one (a threshold, a half, a product) derives it in its own code from this name, never types it.
